name: io.github.chico10117/tron-usdt-mcp
title: TRON USDT Risk Checker
description: TRON USDT risk: free Tether blacklist check, paid sanctions screen and AML report.

environmentVariables.name: TRON_USDT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key (screen:write scope) for the paid tools, 1 credit per call. Create one at https://usdt.chikocorp.com/settings.

environmentVariables.name: TRON_USDT_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Remote MCP endpoint. Must be https (plain http is accepted only for localhost).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bearer API key with screen:write scope for the paid tools (1 credit per call). Omit to use the free tool or pay per call with x402.
